advice.do_not_share_pin: Ungahlali ufaka i-PIN noma i-OTP nayi-munye — hhayi nabasebenzi bakaMukuru.
advice.do_not_pay_upfront: Imisebenzi nemiklomelo yeqiniso ayifuni inkokhelo phambilana.

advice.do_not_click_link: Ungachofozi ixhuma. Bhala ikheli lewebhu ngokwakho.
advice.pause_and_confirm: Misa lo hudulo uqinisekise ubuqiniso bomamukeli kuqala.
advice.report_scam: Bika lokhu ebhange lakho noma ku-SABRIC.
advice.trust_your_instincts: Uma kuzwakala kungelungile, misa. Xoxa nomuntu owethembayo ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
advice.check_url: Hlola ikheli lewebhu ngokucophelela — abakohlisi basebenzisa amakheli afana neqiniso.

sms.scam_of_week.body: Isaziso sikaMukuru: Qaphela imisebenzi eqanjiwe ecela imali yokubhalisa e-R500. Imisebenzi yeqiniso ayifuni inkokhelo phambilana. Hlala uphephile!
panic.confirm.title: Vula Imodi Yezimo Eziphuthumayo
panic.confirm.body: Lokhu kuzobonisa i-akhawunti yomfanekiso engenali. Isaziso esithulile sizothunyelwa kumxhumano wakho othenjwayo.
panic.trusted_contact.alert: Ukubhekwa KukaMukuru: Imodi yezimo eziphuthumayo yavulwa ku-akhawunti yomxhumana wakho ngo-{timestamp}. Sicela ubheke kuye.
login_guard.title: Umlindi Wokungena
login_guard.checkin_question: Ngabe umuntu omhlangane naye ku-intanethi ukucelile imali?
login_guard.no_response: Kulungile. Uma kube nokuguquka, sebenzisa leli thulusi ukukhuphula isaziso.
login_guard.yes_response.title: Isaziso Senkohliso Yothando
login_guard.yes_response.body: Leli yisifanekiso esijwayelekile sezigilamkhuba zothando. Abantu obahlanganayo ku-intanethi abacela imali ngokushesha bayizigilamkhuba kakhulu.
login_guard.risk_raised: Izinga lakho lengozi libuyekeziwe. Sizokuxwayisa uma umsebenzi ubukeka uxhumene nalokhu.

demo.sample_scams.title: Imiyalezo yezigilamkhuba yesibonelo
demo.sample_scams.fake_job: Halala! Ukhethiwe ukusebenza ekhaya uhholela u-R5000 ngesonto. Ukuze uqalise isikhundla sakho, khokha imali yokubhalisa e-R500 nge-EFT. Xhumana nathi ku-WhatsApp +27600000001 ukuqinisekisa.
demo.sample_scams.phishing: ABSA BANK: I-akhawunti yakho ikhiyiwe. Qinisekisa manje ku-www.absa-secure-login.co ukuze kuvulwe kabusha.
demo.sample_scams.romance: Ntombi yami, ngikhiwe ekhaya e-Dubai. Badinga u-$300 ukuze bakhulule impahla yami. Ngizokubuyisela kabili uma ngifika. Ngiyakucela, ngiyakuthanda.
demo.sample_scams.advance_fee: Mhlonishwa Osizakele, ukhethiwe ukuthola u-$1.5 million. Ukuze ufumane izimali, khokha imali yokucubungula e-$200 kuqala.
demo.sample_scams.impersonation: SARS ISAZISO: Unezimali zokubuyiswa u-R3,200. Zifumane ku-www.sars-refund-portal.net ngaphakathi kwamahora angama-24.
common.error: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Sicela uzame futhi.
